name: Regency Fincorp Limited
about: Regency Fincorp Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. It offers micro-business/personal loans, merchant financing, MSME loans, and women entrepreneurs' loans, as well as loans against property. The company also provides short-term loans for purchasing inventory, business expansion, plant and machinery, display panels, and office furniture and automation, as well as mining equipment loans. In addition, the company provides credit assessment, risk management, and digital onboarding services. It serves households, as well as micro, small, and medium enterprises. The company was formerly known as Regency Investments Limited. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Zirakpur, India.
